newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Profit warning hits M&R shares.
newsitem.headline: Profit warning hits M&R shares.

text.p: Shares in Murray and Roberts dipped on Monday on the back of a company warning that it expected earnings per share for the six months to end December to be lower than the same period in 1995.
By 1105 GMT the company's shares dropped 150 cents to 10.95 rand as 475,500 shares changed hands.
"The company warned that it was expecting lower share earnings so people are trading on that," one broker said.
In its cautionary statement, the firm said the lower results would come despite significant non-operating profits on disposals.
It said it would announce the interim results on Thurday, February 27 and warned shareholders to exercise caution when dealing in its shares until that date.
